description: Wait until a message arrives in an inbox (up to 55 seconds) and return it with its text, codes and links. Returns at once if a matching message is already there. Free; needs the inbox id and secret.

after.description: only a message with a sequence number above this (the seq of the last one you saw)

from.description: only a message whose sender contains this text

inbox_id.description: the inbox id returned by create_inbox

secret.description: the inbox secret returned by create_inbox

subject_contains.description: only a message whose subject contains this text

timeout.description: seconds to wait for a message

name: wait_for_message
title: Wait for a message
